title: Container Bookings: amendment allowance, fee and lead time by tier
content:
## Scope
This table covers the Container Bookings product line and gives, per tier, how many amendments a booking may receive without an amendment fee, the fee for each amendment beyond that allowance, the latest point before the cargo cut-off at which an amendment may be received, and the largest quantity increase an amendment may make.

## What each setting means
- **Free amendments**: amendments per booking accepted without an amendment fee.
- **Amendment fee**: USD per amendment beyond the free allowance.
- **Amendment lead time**: the latest an amendment may be received, in hours before the cargo cut-off.
- **Quantity increase limit**: the maximum increase of the container count by amendment, as a percentage of the confirmed count, rounded down to whole containers.

## Tier table
| Tier | Free amendments | Amendment fee (USD) | Amendment lead time (hours before cargo cut-off) | Quantity increase limit (percent of confirmed count) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Spot Saver | 1 | 75.00 | 72 | 0 |
| AHL Spot Flex | 2 | 60.00 | 48 | 25 |
| AHL Contract Booking | 3 | 50.00 | 48 | 50 |
| AHL Contract Priority | 5 | 40.00 | 24 | 50 |
| AHL Guaranteed Loading | 3 | 50.00 | 48 | 0 |
| AHL Premium Express | 6 | 35.00 | 24 | 25 |

## Hypothetical illustration of the quantity limit
*Hypothetical counts, for illustration only.* The limit is a percentage of the confirmed count, rounded down to whole containers:
- a confirmed count of 10 on a 25 percent tier gives 2.5, rounded down to at most 2 added containers;
- a confirmed count of 10 on a 50 percent tier gives at most 5 added containers;
- on a tier whose limit is 0 percent (AHL Spot Saver, AHL Guaranteed Loading) no container may be added by amendment.

## Points of judgement
**Which tier gives the most free amendments?** AHL Premium Express, with 6; AHL Spot Saver gives only 1.
